description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using LightningJS framework. It creates a visual loader with animated circles that fade in and out, and includes methods to start the animation.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a loading indicator with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the interval loop that toggles the alpha value for fade-in and fade-out animation of the loader circles.
